environment.description: Node.js 20.x Apollo Server 4.x with pgBouncer 1.21 in transaction pooling mode (prepared_statement_mode=auto, server_tls_sslmode=require). The application connects through pgBouncer on port 6432 with statement-level query parameterization enforced. Database queries use extended query protocol with binary parameter binding. The pgBouncer instance has max_client_conn=100 and default_pool_size=20 with server_reset_query='DISCARD ALL'. Connection string includes options='-c statement_timeout=5000'.
